node_classes.label: Unselected Node
node_classes.kv_boundary: No persistent KV operating boundary selected yet
node_classes.summary: The bounded introductory Node type. An established Unselected Node preserves device continuity while you learn how StegVerse works and choose a persistent operating boundary.

node_classes.label: Private Sovereign Node
node_classes.kv_boundary: Private KV remains under the owner-controlled Node boundary
node_classes.summary: Private user or organization sovereignty with Node continuity and governed capabilities without requiring resident StegOS.

node_classes.label: Main Ecosystem Node
node_classes.kv_boundary: Ecosystem services do not become custodian of a private KV
node_classes.summary: Shared ecosystem participation under common StegVerse services without implying private-KV custody or resident StegOS.

node_classes.label: Private Sovereign StegOS Node
node_classes.kv_boundary: Private KV can be used by admitted resident workloads without ecosystem custody
node_classes.summary: Private sovereignty plus an eligible resident StegOS execution environment for governed local or private workloads.

node_classes.label: Ecosystem Sovereign StegOS Node
node_classes.kv_boundary: Ecosystem state and evidence remain separate from private user KV unless explicitly shared and admitted
node_classes.summary: Ecosystem-governed resident StegOS infrastructure for common services and canonical public workloads.
